# Notify

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Post a status card to the job summary, Slack, and/or Discord

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/notify@v1
  with:
    title: # Headline for the notification.
```

## How it works

Report a pipeline outcome to the job summary and, optionally, Slack or Discord.

Deploy and release pipelines all want the same thing: a compact status card with a link
back to the run. Doing it here means one payload shape across every pipeline and no
webhook URL pasted into five workflows.

Every destination is optional and silently skipped when its URL is empty, so the same
step works in a repo that has Slack wired up and one that doesn't. The job summary is on
by default because it costs nothing and is always visible.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | no | `success` | success \| failure \| cancelled \| warning \| info. Drives the colour and icon. |
| `title` | **yes** | — | Headline for the notification. |
| `text` | no | `""` | Markdown body. Slack renders mrkdwn; Discord and the summary render Markdown. |
| `fields` | no | `{}` | JSON object of short key/value pairs rendered as a table, e.g. `{"Environment":"prod","Version":"v1.4.0"}`. |
| `url` | no | `""` | Primary link (deployment URL, release page). Empty links to the run. |
| `slack-webhook` | no | `""` | Slack incoming-webhook URL. Empty disables Slack. |
| `discord-webhook` | no | `""` | Discord webhook URL. Empty disables Discord. |
| `summary` | no | `true` | true to append the card to the GitHub job summary. |

## Outputs

_No outputs._
